subject.title: fix(agents): repair orphaned tool_use pairs on compaction prune path

question: Should built-in compaction use the same drop policy as prompt-send replay for aborted assistant tool-call turns that have no matching tool result?
rationale: The patch is narrow and strongly evidenced, but dropping an aborted assistant turn instead of synthesizing an error result is a session-history policy choice about interrupted context preservation.

options.title: Accept drop policy
options.body: Merge the PR after normal maintainer review and keep aborted, unpaired assistant tool-call turns out of built-in compaction summaries.

options.title: Require synthesis policy
options.body: Ask for a revised PR that inserts a clearly synthetic interrupted tool result and preserves the assistant turn when safe.

options.title: Defer recovery design
options.body: Keep the linked issue open and reject this PR until maintainers decide broader transcript recovery policy.

recommendation.title: Accept drop policy
recommendation.body: Merge the PR after normal maintainer review and keep aborted, unpaired assistant tool-call turns out of built-in compaction summaries.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal for both compaction and shared transcript repair points to this owner candidate.
